parameter_inspection.path_scope: project/document/object/occurrence/parameter as returned by inspection; names are escaped per segment
parameter_inspection.structured_values: discoverable but not sampled as primitives
parameter_inspection.time: placement root authored time when placement is present; otherwise target document authored time; source clocks apply once

project_authoring.inspection: Native provider records are under native; scenes include read-only object_sources. Project candidates inspect all changed documents before atomic Apply.

catalog.notes: Layer positions are design pixels; time is exact Composition time. Identities are literal UUIDs. Moving both range edges equally moves the source clock; trimming retains it. Keyframe updates preserve key identity/tangents; new keys are Linear. Locks include locked ancestors. Format changes do not retime or resize existing source documents.

default.description: Scalar, vector or color components. Component count is part of the interface.

images.description:
Image names map to ordinary source-less leaf layers. Repeated image use
may be authored by mapping multiple leaves to the same published input.

Graph.description:
Invocation-local routing into a referenced graph layer. Keys belong to the
child interface; values name ports in this Composition's published interface.

Handle.description:
Handle time is a fraction of its adjacent interval (0..=0.5), value is
an offset from the key. Bounded fractions guarantee monotone Bézier time.

oneOf.description: Holds the next value between keys; exact key times retain their own values.

RotationSample.description:
Read-only quaternion context for a projected component curve. Key edits update
the selected component; the owning typed track normalizes the coupled value.

Time.description: Normalized rational seconds. Denominators are positive; arithmetic never wraps.

catalog.notes: Native operation records own stable node/parameter identities. Catalog record IDs are deterministic examples; allocate fresh IDs for new nodes and parameters. Unknown versions are unresolved and non-executable. Source is an identity-preserving scoped projection. All edits pass the same protection and document transaction gates.

operations.inputs: map of input name to node identity

operations.record: shared versioned Node record; retain node and parameter identities

operations.space: OCIO input color space or null

oneOf.description: Holds the next value between keys; exact key times retain their own values.

handles.description: Component handles share this key's identity and exact time.

interpolation.description: Segment beginning at this key. Endpoint extrapolation always holds.

oneOf.description: Unit quaternion in x/y/z/w order. Euler construction requires an order.

Time.description: Normalized rational seconds. Denominators are positive; arithmetic never wraps.

base.description: Explicit base for Add/Multiply; replacement has no base.

oneOf.description: Named-channel image data; color/alpha metadata belongs to the image resource.

path.description: Absolute destination path. Existing files are never replaced.

dimensions.description: Full output raster size, before any region extraction.

time.description: Exact output-relative time in the registered output's half-open duration.

document.description: None discovers the project. A document filter limits the work.

owner.description: Unescaped project path of the owning node/container.

time.description: Authored document time; the provider applies nested clocks.

FrameRegion.description: Pixel rectangle in the full output raster; it does not change camera framing.

Key.description:
Identity of a native graph parameter or a fixed provider-owned property.
Property names are contract keys, never user labels or JSON pointers.

Placement.description:
Placement of a source document below a root document. The ordered owner IDs
distinguish repeated uses of the same source. Names are never stored here.

ProjectGuard.description: Project-wide operations deliberately have no document-edit scope.

object.description: Feature-owned object, such as a Motion scene object.

occurrence.description: Ordered native instance IDs below the document's root instance.
